name: cierre-de-turno
description: A thirty-second voice note (or text note) that closes your workday from your public GitHub activity: what you closed, what is still open, why it is stuck, and where to start tomorrow. No account, no streaks, no wellness questionnaire. The web app is free; the MCP is a one-time 5 USDC payment (x402, Base mainnet), no subscription.

payment.howToBuy: GET /api/comprar returns HTTP 402 with a standard PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; pay with any x402 client (x402-fetch, Dexter) and retry with X-PAYMENT. The response contains the license token for the x-license header.

trust.data: reads public GitHub activity only; stores only license hashes and usage counts
trust.reliability: deterministic blocker extraction; script built from hand-written sentence frames guarded against hallucination
